title: arthrostemma pumilum
intro: Arthrostemma pumilum, commonly known as the "Bitter Apple", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The Bitter Apple plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Bitter Apple plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
